judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking sky photo with a bright, sculptural cumulus mass rising above dark layered clouds, though the foreground silhouette is somewhat messy.
strengths: striking contrast between bright billowing cloud top and dark layered base
good sense of depth from stacked cloud layers
weaknesses: silhouetted foreground trees are a bit cluttered
lower cloud deck is heavy and flat
